missions.name: 1 · First Landing
missions.description: Beach invasion — land on the island and take both towns. (Easy)

missions.name: 2 · Brothers at War
missions.description: Civil war — cross the river and crush the rebellion.

missions.name: 3 · The Mountain Passes
missions.description: Nation vs nation — force the two fortified passes.

missions.name: 4 · Isle Campaign
missions.description: Island hopping — take three enemy isles with marines and gunboats.

missions.name: 5 · Two-Front Gambit
missions.description: Two hostile nations, one on each border. Survive, then conquer both.

missions.name: 6 · The Greywater Crossing
missions.description: Force a fortified river line over three defended bridges.

missions.name: 7 · Winter Citadel
missions.description: Break into a fortified mountain ring held by a rich garrison.

missions.name: 8 · The Shattered Realm
missions.description: Four-way war of warlords. You start smallest — unify the realm.

missions.name: 9 · Ironshore
missions.description: D-Day. Storm a fortified coast under fire and crack the mainland. (Hard)

missions.name: 10 · World at War
missions.description: Finale — three empires against your small republic. (Very hard)
